title: Enforce Customer Managed KMS Encryption (SSE-KMS)
description: Ensures all objects stored in S3 are automatically encrypted at rest using a dedicated KMS Customer Managed Key (CMK) with automated key rotation and separate key administration.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group vpc(logos:network-vpc)[Amazon VPC]
    service client(logos:iam-access)[Authorized Client] in vpc
    service s3(logos:storage-s3)[Amazon S3 Vault] in vpc
    service kms(logos:security-kms)[AWS KMS CMK Key] in vpc
    client:R --> L:s3
    s3:R --> L:kms
opa_policy:
package aws.storage_s3.s3_bucket_kms_encryption

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer Managed KMS Encryption (SSE-KMS)
# Compliance: CIS AWS 2.1.1, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS 3.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration"
  rule := r.change.after.rule[_]
  apply := rule.apply_server_side_encryption_by_default[_]
  apply.sse_algorithm != "aws:kms"
  msg := sprintf("S3 Bucket %v must use aws:kms server-side encryption", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in AWS Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce All S3 Block Public Access Controls
description: Enforces account and bucket-level Block Public Access controls (BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets) to eliminate accidental exposure.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    service internet(logos:network-vpc)[Public Traffic]
    service s3(logos:storage-s3)[Protected S3 Bucket]
    service sechub(logos:compliance-sechub)[Security Hub Guard]
    internet:R --> L:s3
    s3:B --> T:sechub
opa_policy:
package aws.storage_s3.s3_public_access_block

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce All S3 Block Public Access Controls
# Compliance: CIS AWS 2.1.5, NIST 800-53 AC-3, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block"
  block := r.change.after
  not (block.block_public_acls == true &&
       block.ignore_public_acls == true &&
       block.block_public_policy == true &&
       block.restrict_public_buckets == true)
  msg := sprintf("S3 Public Access Block %v must enable all 4 public access protections", [r.address])
}
terraform:
resource "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block" "block_all_public" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.secure_bucket.id

  block_public_acls       = true
  block_public_policy     = true
  ignore_public_acls      = true
  restrict_public_buckets = true
}
remediation: Inspect resource in AWS Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce In-Transit Encryption via aws:SecureTransport
description: Attaches an explicit Deny bucket policy that rejects any HTTP requests where aws:SecureTransport is false, mandating TLS 1.2+ for all API interactions.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    service client(logos:iam-access)[TLS Client]
    service s3(logos:storage-s3)[Amazon S3 TLS Endpoint]
    service trail(logos:logging-cloudtrail)[CloudTrail Auditing]
    client:R --> L:s3
    s3:B --> T:trail
opa_policy:
package aws.storage_s3.s3_enforce_tls

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce In-Transit Encryption via aws:SecureTransport
# Compliance: CIS AWS 2.1.2, PCI-DSS 4.1, HIPAA 164.312(e)(1)
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "aws_s3_bucket_policy"
  policy := json.unmarshal(r.change.after.policy)
  statement := policy.Statement[_]
  statement.Effect == "Deny"
  statement.Condition.Bool["aws:SecureTransport"] != "false"
  msg := sprintf("S3 Bucket Policy %v must explicitly deny non-HTTPS requests via aws:SecureTransport", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in AWS Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

mermaid:
architecture-beta
    service app(logos:compute-ec2)[Writing Workload]
    service s3(logos:storage-s3)[Immutable WORM S3]
    service kms(logos:security-kms)[AWS KMS Envelope]
    app:R --> L:s3
    s3:R --> L:kms
opa_policy:
package aws.storage_s3.s3_object_lock_compliance_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable S3 Object Lock in Compliance Mode for WORM Protection (Tier 5 - Profile T)
# Compliance: SEC Rule 17a-4(f), CFTC Rule 1.31, NIST 800-53 SC-28
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "aws_s3_bucket_object_lock_configuration"
  rule := r.change.after.rule[_]
  mode := rule.default_retention[_].mode
  mode != "COMPLIANCE"
  msg := sprintf("S3 Object Lock %v must use COMPLIANCE mode for immutable WORM enforcement", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in AWS Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Restrict S3 Bucket Access Exclusively to VPC Endpoint (Tier 6 - Profile U)
description: Attaches an authorization condition checking aws:sourceVpce to lock bucket access strictly inside a designated VPC gateway endpoint, preventing data exfiltration outside corporate network paths. Hardened for enterprise tier 6 (U) deployment standards.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group vpc(logos:network-vpc)[Amazon VPC]
    service ec2(logos:compute-ec2)[Private Workload] in vpc
    service vpce(logos:network-vpc)[S3 Gateway Endpoint] in vpc
    service s3(logos:storage-s3)[Amazon S3 Bucket]
    ec2:R --> L:vpce
    vpce:R --> L:s3
opa_policy:
package aws.storage_s3.s3_vpc_endpoint_restriction_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict S3 Bucket Access Exclusively to VPC Endpoint (Tier 6 - Profile U)
# Compliance: CIS AWS 2.1.6, NIST 800-53 AC-4, PCI-DSS 1.3
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "aws_s3_bucket_policy"
  policy := json.unmarshal(r.change.after.policy)
  stmt := policy.Statement[_]
  stmt.Effect == "Deny"
  not stmt.Condition.StringNotEquals["aws:sourceVpce"]
  msg := sprintf("S3 policy %v must contain StringNotEquals aws:sourceVpce condition", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in AWS Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group vpc(logos:network-vpc)[Amazon VPC]
    service client(logos:iam-access)[Authorized Client] in vpc
    service s3(logos:storage-s3)[Amazon S3 Vault] in vpc

    client:R --> L:s3
    s3:R --> L:kms
opa_policy:
package aws.storage_s3.s3_bucket_kms_encryption_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer Managed KMS Encryption (SSE-KMS) (Tier 6 - Profile V)
# Compliance: CIS AWS 2.1.1, NIST 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS 3.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration"

title: Enforce All S3 Block Public Access Controls (Tier 6 - Profile W)
description: Enforces account and bucket-level Block Public Access controls (BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets) to eliminate accidental exposure. Hardened for enterprise tier 6 (W) deployment standards.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    service internet(logos:network-vpc)[Public Traffic]
    service s3(logos:storage-s3)[Protected S3 Bucket]
    service sechub(logos:compliance-sechub)[Security Hub Guard]
    internet:R --> L:s3
    s3:B --> T:sechub
opa_policy:
package aws.storage_s3.s3_public_access_block_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce All S3 Block Public Access Controls (Tier 6 - Profile W)
# Compliance: CIS AWS 2.1.5, NIST 800-53 AC-3, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block"
  block := r.change.after
  not (block.block_public_acls == true &&
       block.ignore_public_acls == true &&
       block.block_public_policy == true &&
       block.restrict_public_buckets == true)
  msg := sprintf("S3 Public Access Block %v must enable all 4 public access protections", [r.address])
}
terraform:
resource "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block" "block_all_public" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.secure_bucket.id

  block_public_acls       = true
  block_public_policy     = true
  ignore_public_acls      = true
  restrict_public_buckets = true
}
remediation: Inspect resource in AWS Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

    s3:B --> T:trail

package aws.storage_s3.s3_enforce_tls_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce In-Transit Encryption via aws:SecureTransport (Tier 6 - Profile X)
# Compliance: CIS AWS 2.1.2, PCI-DSS 4.1, HIPAA 164.312(e)(1)
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce MFA Authentication for All IAM Console Users (Tier 9 - Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS AWS 1.5, NIST 800-53 IA-2(1), PCI-DSS 8.3
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "aws_iam_account_password_policy"
  r.change.after.require_symbols != true
  msg := sprintf("IAM Password Policy %v must require symbols", [r.address])
}
terraform:
resource "aws_iam_account_password_policy" "strict" {
  minimum_password_length        = 16
  require_lowercase_characters   = true
  require_numbers                = true
  require_uppercase_characters   = true
  require_symbols                = true
  allow_users_to_change_password = true
  password_reuse_prevention      = 24
  max_password_age               = 90
}
remediation: Inspect resource in AWS Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Require ExternalId for Cross-Account Third-Party Delegation Roles (Tier 9 - Profile I)
description: Protects cross-account IAM trust relationships against the Confused Deputy problem by requiring a unique, cryptographically strong ExternalId. Hardened for enterprise tier 9 (I) deployment standards.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    service vendor(logos:iam-access)[Vendor Account]
    service iam(logos:iam-access)[Target Role Trust]
    service sts(logos:security-kms)[AWS STS Issuer]
    vendor:R --> L:iam
    iam:R --> L:sts
opa_policy:
package aws.iam_access.iam_external_id_check_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Require ExternalId for Cross-Account Third-Party Delegation Roles (Tier 9 - Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS AWS 1.16, AWS Well-Architected SEC-03, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "aws_iam_role"
  policy := json.unmarshal(r.change.after.assume_role_policy)
  stmt := policy.Statement[_]
  not stmt.Condition.StringEquals["sts:ExternalId"]
  msg := sprintf("IAM Role %v trust policy must enforce sts:ExternalId condition", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in AWS Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

    service oidc(logos:iam-access)[IAM OIDC Provider]
    service sts(logos:security-kms)[AWS STS Tokens]
    runner:R --> L:oidc
    oidc:R --> L:sts
opa_policy:

  r.type == "aws_iam_openid_connect_provider"

    group vpc(logos:network-vpc)[Amazon VPC Private Subnet]

opa_policy:
package aws.compute_ec2.ec2_imdsv2_enforced_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce IMDSv2 Token Requirement on All EC2 Instances (Tier 7 - Profile Z)
# Compliance: CIS AWS 5.6, NIST 800-53 SC-34, AWS Well-Architected SEC-02
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "aws_instance"
  imds := r.change.after.metadata_options[_]
  imds.http_tokens != "required"
  msg := sprintf("EC2 Instance %v must enforce IMDSv2 (http_tokens = required)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in AWS Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package aws.database_rds.rds_multiaz_backup

default allow = false

package aws.nosql_dynamodb.dynamodb_kms_cmk_t4

default allow = false

}

}

opa_policy:
package azure.network.nsg_default_deny
default allow = false
deny[msg] {
  input.type == "azurerm_network_security_rule"
  input.values.access == "Allow"
  input.values.source_address_prefix == "*"
  input.values.destination_port_range == "*"
  msg := "Wildcard allow rules on NSGs are prohibited"
}
terraform:
resource "azurerm_network_security_group" "strict_nsg" {
  name = "app-nsg-${var.env}"
  security_rule {
    name                       = "Deny-All-Inbound"
    priority                   = 4096
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Deny"
    protocol                   = "*"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "*"
    source_address_prefix      = "*"
    destination_address_prefix = "*"
  }
}
remediation: Add a high priority rule (4096) denying all traffic on NSG.

terraform:
name: Security Scan
on: [push]
jobs:
  trivy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          image-ref: '${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}'
          format: 'table'
          exit-code: '1'
          ignore-unfixed: true
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'
remediation: Configure Trivy action in CI with exit-code: 1 on CRITICAL/HIGH findings.

opa_policy:
package container.distroless.no_package_manager
default allow = false
deny[msg] {
  input.dockerfile.commands[_].name == "RUN"
  input.dockerfile.commands[_].args[_] == "apt-get"
  msg := "Runtime container images must use distroless base; package managers prohibited"
}
terraform:
FROM golang:1.24-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o secure-binary main.go

FROM cgr.dev/chainguard/static:latest
COPY --from=builder /app/secure-binary /secure-binary
USER 65534:65534
ENTRYPOINT ["/secure-binary"]
remediation: Switch Dockerfile base to cgr.dev/chainguard/static or gcr.io/distroless/static.

package container.ebpf.no_interactive_shell
default allow = false
deny[msg] {
  input.event == "execve"
  input.binary == "/bin/sh"
  msg := "Interactive shell execution detected in container via eBPF; process killed"
}
terraform:
- rule: Terminal shell in container
  desc: A shell was spawned by a container in production
  condition: >
    spawned_process and container
    and proc.name in (bash, sh, zsh, ksh)
  output: >
    Shell spawned in container (user=%user.name container=%container.id cmd=%proc.cmdline)
  priority: CRITICAL

package cnapp.azure.azure_ad_rule_1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce MFA for All Administrative and Privileged Directory Roles
# Provider: Azure | Service: Microsoft Entra ID
# Pillar: CIEM | Severity: Critical
# Compliance Frameworks: CIS Azure 1.1, NIST 800-53 IA-2, PCI-DSS 8.3

# Allow strictly when compliance guardrail is validated
allow {
    input.provider == "Azure"
    input.resource_type == "azure_ad"
    input.security_policy.azure_ad_enforced == true
    not violation
}

# Deny condition and violation detection
deny[msg] {
    input.provider == "Azure"
    input.resource_type == "azure_ad"
    not input.security_policy.azure_ad_enforced == true
    msg := sprintf("CNAPP Violation: %v [%v] - Enforce MFA for All Administrative and Privileged Directory Roles is not properly configured according to %v", [input.id, "Critical", "CIS Azure 1.1"])
}

violation {
    input.security_policy.disabled == true
}

package cnapp.azure.azure_blob_rule_3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce HTTPS and Minimum TLS 1.2 on All REST API Storage Endpoints
# Provider: Azure | Service: Azure Blob Storage
# Pillar: DSPM | Severity: High
# Compliance Frameworks: CIS Azure 3.3, NIST SC-8, PCI-DSS 4.1

# Allow strictly when compliance guardrail is validated
allow {
    input.provider == "Azure"
    input.resource_type == "azure_blob"
    input.security_policy.azure_blob_enforced == true
    not violation
}

# Deny condition and violation detection
deny[msg] {
    input.provider == "Azure"
    input.resource_type == "azure_blob"
    not input.security_policy.azure_blob_enforced == true
    msg := sprintf("CNAPP Violation: %v [%v] - Enforce HTTPS and Minimum TLS 1.2 on All REST API Storage Endpoints is not properly configured according to %v", [input.id, "High", "CIS Azure 3.3"])
}

violation {
    input.security_policy.disabled == true
}

resource "azurerm_resource_group" "rg" {
  name     = "rg-cnapp-azure-blob-prod"
  location = "eastus2"
}

  name                 = "cnapp-enforce-azure-blob-3"
  scope                = azurerm_resource_group.rg.id

  })

package cnapp.azure.azure_blob_rule_10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Diagnostic Settings Forwarding Storage Read/Write Logs to Log Analytics
# Provider: Azure | Service: Azure Blob Storage
# Pillar: DSPM | Severity: Medium
# Compliance Frameworks: CIS Azure 5.1, NIST AU-2, SOC 2 CC7.2

    input.provider == "Azure"
    input.resource_type == "azure_blob"
    input.security_policy.azure_blob_enforced == true
    not violation
}

    input.resource_type == "azure_blob"

}

violation {
    input.security_policy.disabled == true
}

    input.provider == "Azure"
    input.resource_type == "azure_aks"
    input.security_policy.azure_aks_enforced == true

}

}

violation {

}

package cnapp.azure.azure_defender_rule_7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Automated Remediation Playbooks for Critical Security Alerts via Logic Apps
# Provider: Azure | Service: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
# Pillar: CSPM | Severity: High
# Compliance Frameworks: NIST IR-4, PCI-DSS 12.10, SOC 2 CC7.4

# Allow strictly when compliance guardrail is validated
allow {
    input.provider == "Azure"
    input.resource_type == "azure_defender"
    input.security_policy.azure_defender_enforced == true
    not violation
}

# Deny condition and violation detection
deny[msg] {
    input.provider == "Azure"
    input.resource_type == "azure_defender"
    not input.security_policy.azure_defender_enforced == true
    msg := sprintf("CNAPP Violation: %v [%v] - Enforce Automated Remediation Playbooks for Critical Security Alerts via Logic Apps is not properly configured according to %v", [input.id, "High", "NIST IR-4"])
}

violation {
    input.security_policy.disabled == true
}

resource "azurerm_resource_group" "rg" {

  location = "eastus2"

opa_policy:
package cnapp.azure.azure_monitor_rule_5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Azure Activity Log Continuous Export to Dedicated Log Analytics Storage
# Provider: Azure | Service: Azure Monitor & Sentinel
# Pillar: CSPM | Severity: High
# Compliance Frameworks: CIS Azure 5.1.1, NIST AU-2, SOC 2 CC7.1

# Allow strictly when compliance guardrail is validated
allow {
    input.provider == "Azure"
    input.resource_type == "azure_monitor"
    input.security_policy.azure_monitor_enforced == true
    not violation
}

# Deny condition and violation detection
deny[msg] {
    input.provider == "Azure"
    input.resource_type == "azure_monitor"
    not input.security_policy.azure_monitor_enforced == true
    msg := sprintf("CNAPP Violation: %v [%v] - Enable Azure Activity Log Continuous Export to Dedicated Log Analytics Storage is not properly configured according to %v", [input.id, "High", "CIS Azure 5.1.1"])
}

violation {
    input.security_policy.disabled == true
}
terraform:
# Provider: Azure
# Architecture Guardrail: Enable Azure Activity Log Continuous Export to Dedicated Log Analytics Storage
# Compliance: CIS Azure 5.1.1, NIST AU-2, SOC 2 CC7.1
# CNAPP Pillar: CSPM | Severity: High

resource "azurerm_resource_group" "rg" {
  name     = "rg-cnapp-azure-monitor-prod"
  location = "eastus2"
}

resource "azurerm_policy_assignment" "guardrail_5" {
  name                 = "cnapp-enforce-azure-monitor-5"
  scope                = azurerm_resource_group.rg.id
  policy_definition_id = "/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyDefinitions/builtin-azure_monitor"
  description          = "Unified CNAPP Enforcement: Enable Azure Activity Log Continuous Export to Dedicated Log Analytics Storage"
  display_name         = "Enforce Enable Azure Activity Log Continuous Export to Dedicated Log Analytics Storage"

  metadata = jsonencode({
    category   = "Azure Monitor & Microsoft Sentinel SIEM"
    pillar     = "CSPM"
    compliance = ["CIS Azure 5.1.1","NIST AU-2","SOC 2 CC7.1"]
    severity   = "High"
  })
}
remediation: Verify and enforce 'Enable Azure Activity Log Continuous Export to Dedicated Log Analytics Storage' in accordance with CIS Azure 5.1.1. Review configuration in Azure console or deploy compliant IaC/policy manifest. Ensure automated continuous posture compliance monitoring is active.

package cnapp.gcp.gcp_gke_rule_8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Pod Security Standards via GKE Policy Controller (Gatekeeper)
# Provider: GCP | Service: Google Kubernetes Engine
# Pillar: KSPM | Severity: Critical
# Compliance Frameworks: CIS Kubernetes 5.2, NIST 800-190 4.1, MITRE ATT&CK T1610

# Allow strictly when compliance guardrail is validated
allow {
    input.provider == "GCP"
    input.resource_type == "gcp_gke"
    input.security_policy.gcp_gke_enforced == true
    not violation
}

# Deny condition and violation detection
deny[msg] {
    input.provider == "GCP"
    input.resource_type == "gcp_gke"
    not input.security_policy.gcp_gke_enforced == true
    msg := sprintf("CNAPP Violation: %v [%v] - Enforce Pod Security Standards via GKE Policy Controller (Gatekeeper) is not properly configured according to %v", [input.id, "Critical", "CIS Kubernetes 5.2"])
}

violation {
    input.security_policy.disabled == true
}
remediation: Verify and enforce 'Enforce Pod Security Standards via GKE Policy Controller (Gatekeeper)' in accordance with CIS Kubernetes 5.2. Review configuration in GCP console or deploy compliant IaC/policy manifest. Ensure automated continuous posture compliance monitoring is active.

package cnapp.gcp.gcp_kms_rule_1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Automated 90-Day Key Rotation for Cloud KMS CryptoKeys
# Provider: GCP | Service: Google Cloud Key Management
# Pillar: DSPM | Severity: High
# Compliance Frameworks: CIS GCP 1.9, NIST SC-12, PCI-DSS 3.6.4

# Allow strictly when compliance guardrail is validated
allow {
    input.provider == "GCP"
    input.resource_type == "gcp_kms"
    input.security_policy.gcp_kms_enforced == true
    not violation
}

# Deny condition and violation detection
deny[msg] {
    input.provider == "GCP"
    input.resource_type == "gcp_kms"
    not input.security_policy.gcp_kms_enforced == true
    msg := sprintf("CNAPP Violation: %v [%v] - Enforce Automated 90-Day Key Rotation for Cloud KMS CryptoKeys is not properly configured according to %v", [input.id, "High", "CIS GCP 1.9"])
}

violation {
    input.security_policy.disabled == true
}
remediation: Verify and enforce 'Enforce Automated 90-Day Key Rotation for Cloud KMS CryptoKeys' in accordance with CIS GCP 1.9. Review configuration in GCP console or deploy compliant IaC/policy manifest. Ensure automated continuous posture compliance monitoring is active.

package cnapp.gcp.gcp_scc_rule_1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Security Command Center Premium at the Google Cloud Organization Level
# Provider: GCP | Service: Security Command Center
# Pillar: CSPM | Severity: Critical
# Compliance Frameworks: CIS GCP 2.5, NIST SI-4, SOC 2 CC7.1

# Allow strictly when compliance guardrail is validated
allow {
    input.provider == "GCP"
    input.resource_type == "gcp_scc"
    input.security_policy.gcp_scc_enforced == true
    not violation
}

# Deny condition and violation detection
deny[msg] {
    input.provider == "GCP"
    input.resource_type == "gcp_scc"
    not input.security_policy.gcp_scc_enforced == true
    msg := sprintf("CNAPP Violation: %v [%v] - Enable Security Command Center Premium at the Google Cloud Organization Level is not properly configured according to %v", [input.id, "Critical", "CIS GCP 2.5"])
}

violation {
    input.security_policy.disabled == true
}
remediation: Verify and enforce 'Enable Security Command Center Premium at the Google Cloud Organization Level' in accordance with CIS GCP 2.5. Review configuration in GCP console or deploy compliant IaC/policy manifest. Ensure automated continuous posture compliance monitoring is active.

    input.security_policy.gcp_vpc_enforced == true

}

    input.provider == "GCP"
    input.resource_type == "gcp_vpc"

violation {

package cnapp.gcp.gcp_logging_rule_6

default allow = false

# Rule: Configure Log-Based Alerts for Project Ownership Changes and Role Escalation
# Provider: GCP | Service: Cloud Logging & Chronicle
# Pillar: CSPM | Severity: Critical
# Compliance Frameworks: CIS GCP 2.14, NIST AC-2, PCI-DSS 10.2.2

# Allow strictly when compliance guardrail is validated
allow {
    input.provider == "GCP"
    input.resource_type == "gcp_logging"
    input.security_policy.gcp_logging_enforced == true
    not violation
}

# Deny condition and violation detection
deny[msg] {
    input.provider == "GCP"
    input.resource_type == "gcp_logging"
    not input.security_policy.gcp_logging_enforced == true
    msg := sprintf("CNAPP Violation: %v [%v] - Configure Log-Based Alerts for Project Ownership Changes and Role Escalation is not properly configured according to %v", [input.id, "Critical", "CIS GCP 2.14"])
}

violation {
    input.security_policy.disabled == true
}
remediation: Verify and enforce 'Configure Log-Based Alerts for Project Ownership Changes and Role Escalation' in accordance with CIS GCP 2.14. Review configuration in GCP console or deploy compliant IaC/policy manifest. Ensure automated continuous posture compliance monitoring is active.

package cnapp.kubernetes.k8s_rbac_rule_11

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Node Registration and Enforce NodeRestriction Admission Plugin
# Provider: Kubernetes | Service: Kubernetes RBAC
# Pillar: CIEM | Severity: High
# Compliance Frameworks: CIS Kubernetes 1.2.17, NIST AC-3, SOC 2 CC6.8

# Allow strictly when compliance guardrail is validated
allow {
    input.provider == "Kubernetes"
    input.resource_type == "k8s_rbac"
    input.security_policy.k8s_rbac_enforced == true
    not violation
}

# Deny condition and violation detection
deny[msg] {
    input.provider == "Kubernetes"
    input.resource_type == "k8s_rbac"
    not input.security_policy.k8s_rbac_enforced == true
    msg := sprintf("CNAPP Violation: %v [%v] - Restrict Node Registration and Enforce NodeRestriction Admission Plugin is not properly configured according to %v", [input.id, "High", "CIS Kubernetes 1.2.17"])
}

violation {
    input.security_policy.disabled == true
}
terraform:
# Platform: Kubernetes Native Guardrail (Kyverno / Gatekeeper)
# Architecture Guardrail: Restrict Node Registration and Enforce NodeRestriction Admission Plugin
# Compliance: CIS Kubernetes 1.2.17, NIST AC-3, SOC 2 CC6.8
# CNAPP Pillar: CIEM | Severity: High

apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: cnapp-enforce-k8s-rbac-11
  annotations:
    policies.kyverno.io/title: "Restrict Node Registration and Enforce NodeRestriction Admission Plugin"
    policies.kyverno.io/category: "Kubernetes RBAC & Service Accounts"
    policies.kyverno.io/severity: "high"
    policies.kyverno.io/compliance: "CIS Kubernetes 1.2.17, NIST AC-3, SOC 2 CC6.8"
spec:
  validationFailureAction: Enforce
  background: true
  rules:
    - name: check-k8s-rbac-security
      match:
        any:
          - resources:
              kinds:
                - Pod
                - Deployment
                - StatefulSet
      validate:
        message: "Restrict Node Registration and Enforce NodeRestriction Admission Plugin must be strictly satisfied (CIS Kubernetes 1.2.17)."
        pattern:
          spec:
            template:
              spec:
                securityContext:
                  runAsNonRoot: true
remediation: Verify and enforce 'Restrict Node Registration and Enforce NodeRestriction Admission Plugin' in accordance with CIS Kubernetes 1.2.17. Review configuration in Kubernetes console or deploy compliant IaC/policy manifest. Ensure automated continuous posture compliance monitoring is active.

package cnapp.container.container_docker_rule_1

default allow = false

# Rule: Do Not Run Docker as Root (Enforce Rootless Docker Mode)
# Provider: Container | Service: Docker Engine
# Pillar: CWPP | Severity: Critical
# Compliance Frameworks: CIS Docker 2.6, NIST 800-190 4.1, MITRE ATT&CK T1611

# Allow strictly when compliance guardrail is validated
allow {
    input.provider == "Container"
    input.resource_type == "container_docker"
    input.security_policy.container_docker_enforced == true
    not violation
}

# Deny condition and violation detection
deny[msg] {
    input.provider == "Container"
    input.resource_type == "container_docker"
    not input.security_policy.container_docker_enforced == true
    msg := sprintf("CNAPP Violation: %v [%v] - Do Not Run Docker as Root (Enforce Rootless Docker Mode) is not properly configured according to %v", [input.id, "Critical", "CIS Docker 2.6"])
}

violation {
    input.security_policy.disabled == true
}

package cnapp.container.container_docker_rule_8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Auditd Rules for Docker Daemon and /usr/bin/containerd Binaries
# Provider: Container | Service: Docker Engine
# Pillar: CWPP | Severity: High
# Compliance Frameworks: CIS Docker 1.1.1, NIST AU-2, PCI-DSS 10.2

# Allow strictly when compliance guardrail is validated
allow {
    input.provider == "Container"
    input.resource_type == "container_docker"
    input.security_policy.container_docker_enforced == true
    not violation
}

# Deny condition and violation detection
deny[msg] {
    input.provider == "Container"
    input.resource_type == "container_docker"
    not input.security_policy.container_docker_enforced == true
    msg := sprintf("CNAPP Violation: %v [%v] - Enable Auditd Rules for Docker Daemon and /usr/bin/containerd Binaries is not properly configured according to %v", [input.id, "High", "CIS Docker 1.1.1"])
}

violation {
    input.security_policy.disabled == true
}
terraform:
# Platform: Container & Supply Chain Security (Sigstore / Trivy / eBPF)
# Architecture Guardrail: Enable Auditd Rules for Docker Daemon and /usr/bin/containerd Binaries
# Compliance: CIS Docker 1.1.1, NIST AU-2, PCI-DSS 10.2
# CNAPP Pillar: CWPP | Severity: High

apiVersion: policy.sigstore.dev/v1beta1
kind: ClusterImagePolicy
metadata:
  name: cnapp-image-guardrail-container-docker-8
spec:
  images:
    - glob: "**"
  authorities:
    - keyless:
        url: "https://fulcio.sigstore.dev"
        identities:
          - issuer: "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
            subject: "https://github.com/cloudseccorner/*"
      ctlog:
        url: "https://rekor.sigstore.dev"
  mode: enforce
remediation: Verify and enforce 'Enable Auditd Rules for Docker Daemon and /usr/bin/containerd Binaries' in accordance with CIS Docker 1.1.1. Review configuration in Container console or deploy compliant IaC/policy manifest. Ensure automated continuous posture compliance monitoring is active.
